scenes.title: When certainty gains power
scenes.viewerPurpose: Detach uncorrectable error from lack of intelligence; Identify the proposed limits on uncorrectable authority
scenes.composition: Let a confident speaker keep pointing at a flawed explanation while a listener's correction remains unheard. Give the questioning person a visible route to bring the correction before a reviewer.

scenes.title: Why good arguments lose
scenes.viewerPurpose: Include experts, leaders and ordinary readers in the pattern; Connect reasoning failure to speed and humiliation incentives
scenes.composition: Place expert, leader and ordinary participant on the same level around one decision. Let an interruption cover the careful explanation briefly, then leave the neglected evidence visible.

scenes.title: A culture that can correct itself
scenes.viewerPurpose: Show belonging and ambition shaping decisions; Make correction versus obedience an open political tension
scenes.composition: Bring a decision record past the founder, specialist and applicant so no role stands outside its effects. Hold the questioner facing the leader with the reviewer still able to hear both.

scenes.title: Include yourself in the question
scenes.viewerPurpose: Give intelligence a shared institutional purpose; Invite examination of the definition before blaming others
scenes.composition: Allow a participant to revise one claim while retaining their place in the group. End on the open book beside the unresolved correction, without humiliating the mistaken speaker.
